quotes.text: Remotely configure a cellular network for your readers.

old_evidence.text: Cellular configuration only applies to the Stripe Reader S710.
By default, locations have cellular functionality disabled.
You incur cellular usage fees for a reader when you enable cellular on that reader at any time during a calendar month.
Acknowledge that enabling cellular affects your billing.

findings: The November capture is a Dashboard/API variant index. The old header dates the full cellular configuration guide 2026-05-01. Its workflow covers S710, default disabled per Location, Location assignment, fallback and additional monthly fees.

Dashboard operators enable Cellular under local or inherited configuration, acknowledge the billing impact, save and apply. API integrators can create or update a Configuration with cellular.enabled true and associate the reader with the enabled Location.
substantive_changes: November replaces the combined page in the capture with two .md variant routes. These are navigation only; the retained May full raw remains authority for behavior and no device, fee, configuration or state change follows from omission.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain May’s S710-only scope for this fleet configuration, per-Location disabled default, reader registration and calendar-month billing for each reader enabled at any time, in addition to other fees.

Keep separate setup-network priority and applicability: 2026-04-23 S700/S710 setup lists Ethernet, WiFi, cellular for enabled S710 (raw/stripe-terminal-setup-reader-s700-s710-2025.md:100-110). Preserve historical Dashboard billing acknowledgment and Configuration create/update methods.
conflicts: The mapped summary's WiFi fallback is shorthand. Pair it with the separately documented Ethernet-first priority so absence of WiFi alone does not imply an S710 with usable Ethernet switches to cellular.

The summary should keep 'S710 only' scoped to this remote cellular configuration. The P630 setup guide separately mentions cellular data (raw/stripe-terminal-setup-p630-2025.md:42-44); that does not establish P630 eligibility for the same configuration. Keep it in its own unresolved hardware context.

findings: Add dated November navigation and retain full May details. Keep the S710 network-priority setup route distinct and preserve per-reader monthly billing.
conflicts: Avoid implying automatic switch to cellular during active Ethernet use or extending the fleet configuration to other hardware.
source_assessments.reason: The useful November change is the two-entry variant navigation, with substantive scope retained from May and setup priority separately attributed.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/cellular, the 2026-11-07 capture provides scope and Dashboard/API entry points for source-stripe-terminal-cellular-config, without giving device eligibility, activation, fallback or billing rules (new raw lines 5-14). The full 2026-05-01 guide says the configuration is for Stripe Reader S710. Locations default to disabled, a merchant sets up an enabled Location and registers a reader to it to activate cellular, and the device can automatically use cellular when WiFi is unavailable (old raw lines 8-16). The separate April setup capture lists Ethernet, then WiFi, then cellular for enabled S710 (raw/stripe-terminal-setup-reader-s700-s710-2025.md:100-110). The Dashboard operator enables Cellular, acknowledges billing, saves and applies the location changes. An API integrator creates or updates a Configuration with cellular.enabled true (old raw lines 18-44 and old raw lines 46-79). An enabled reader incurs additional monthly cellular fees if enabled at any point in the calendar month (old raw line 16). The mapped May-based summary captures the device, default, fallback, billing and API basics. Preserve the Dashboard and Ethernet-priority qualifications via the older evidence.
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/fleet/cellular, attach the 2026-11-07 raw to source-stripe-terminal-cellular-config as the Dashboard/API .md variant index (new raw lines 9-14). The structure and navigation changed from the 2026-05-01 full body and embedded routes (old raw lines 18-20 and old raw lines 40-44), without a demonstrated behavioral change. Keep the dated S710 scope, default-disabled Location, enrollment, automatic fallback and per-reader additional monthly billing triggered by any calendar-month enablement, plus the Dashboard acknowledgment and API transition (old raw lines 8-16 and old raw lines 22-44 and old raw lines 46-79). Put network priority on the distinct April S700/S710 setup authority, which gives Ethernet first and then WiFi and cellular (raw/stripe-terminal-setup-reader-s700-s710-2025.md:100-110). The separate P630 setup mention does not extend S710 fleet configuration to that model. Retain both dated raw links, the reciprocal stripe-terminal-hardware-orders, Stripe index and company routes, the parent stripe-terminal reader route and the associated S700/S710 setup guide.
